denial.denialLetterText:
Humana
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: March 10, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 90837 (Psychotherapy, 60 min)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO96 — Non-covered charge(s)

PAYER STATEMENT: Service is not covered under the patient's benefit plan. The requested psychotherapy session exceeds the plan's covered visit limits.

PROCEDURE: 90837 — Psychotherapy, 60 min
DIAGNOSIS: F32.1 — Major depressive disorder, single episode, moderate

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: July 8, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Humana
